comment: Peer penetration benchmark (Opportunity Identification): for each peer group (industry subsector), core product and fiscal year (FY2024, FY2025, FY2026 to date) the number of the peer group's active SMBC APAC clients, how many hold the product, the penetration rate and the median activity of the holders (average balance for balance products, annual volume for flow products). Dense over all peer groups and core products; aggregated from gold.fact_client_product_penetration_annual so the rates match the client-level fact. Combine groups with SUM(peer_group_holders) / SUM(peer_group_clients), not an average of rates. Grain: one row per peer group x core product x fiscal year (dense).
